test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 08 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 452 561 514 232 294 (Right)

(Example- 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

(NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

What will be the resultant if the first digit of the highest number is added to the third

digit of the lowest number?
solution:
Given (Left) 452 561 514 232 294 (Right)

first digit of the highest number - **5**61

third digit of the lowest number - 23**2**

** 5 + 2 = 7.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
